Docs / Review pull requests

Review pull requests

Understand the change, discuss it privately, and choose what to publish.

Review a pull request

  1. Open Pull requests. Filter by Review or My work, or search by title, #number, or @author.
  2. Read checks and activity in PR. Inspect files and commits in WorkBench → Changes.
  3. Select diff lines and choose Add to review. In Submit review, check your comments and choose Comment, Approve, or Request Changes.
  4. Inspect the header’s merge/check-status control when ready to merge. Use Monitor PR to follow updates.

Post now and Reply publish immediately. Add to review keeps comments pending. Monitoring alone does not start CI repair.

Explore code and tests

For a watched PR, open WorkBench → Code & Tests → Create worktree to explore. A local editor uses memory, CPU, and disk; opening it does not start an agent.

  • Use Changes for diffs and Comment for review cards beside the code.
  • Press Shift twice or ⌘⇧F for Search Everywhere; ⌘F searches the current file.
  • Use a test’s play button to run or debug it. Run and Debug retain their results.

On your own PR, Development task opens its conversation without sending a new prompt.

Ask for a private review

First watch the repository and configure a ready Review model in Settings → Agents → Models.

  1. Choose WorkBench → Summary → Start review. For unpublished development work, choose Review changes in the task instead.
  2. Read the explanation and findings. Use View in Changes for code, Review details for evidence, or Ask reviewer for a private discussion.
  3. Choose Add to my review to edit a finding before Submit review publishes it. Request fix → Send to developer asks the development agent to address it privately.
  4. Choose Update review after the PR changes, or Review again for local development changes.

For Could not finish, use Resume review; typing “continue” starts a discussion. If required, use Recover runtime first. Findings remain provisional until the review finishes.

Ask from a review card

  1. On someone else’s review comment, choose Ask agent.
  2. Ask about the reasoning, a fix, or a tradeoff. The PR’s code context is prepared automatically.
  3. Choose Draft with agent for an editable reply. It remains private until you choose Comment.

Resolve locally closes the private discussion without resolving the GitHub thread.

Preview PR and issue links

Hover over a PR or issue link to read its title, status, description, and labels. Move into the card to follow references, or drag its header to keep it open. Choose Open for the full item; Escape dismisses the preview.
